Name: CS_REFLECTION_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Reflection settings for each level of the Reflection Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Reflections Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns reflections on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Local Lights in Reflections
Fields.Description: Lets local (point and spot) lights appear in reflections. Retail: off on Off and Low.

Fields.Name: Force Local Lights in Reflections
Fields.Description: On: local lights are always included in reflections, whatever Local Lights in Reflections is set to. Retail: on for Maximum only.

Fields.Name: Resolution Divider
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 4 on Off and Low, 2 otherwise.

Fields.Name: SSR Enabled
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: SSR Gaussian Blur Enabled
Fields.Description: Allows the Gaussian blur pass on screen-space reflections. Retail: off on Off and Low.

Fields.Name: SSR Depth Reject Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the screen-space reflection depth-reject threshold. Retail: 0.5 Low, 0.75 Medium, 1 High and Maximum.

Fields.Name: SSR Ray Step Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the screen-space reflection ray step; larger steps are cheaper but coarser. Retail: 2 Low, 1.5 Medium, 1 High, 0.5 Maximum.

Fields.Name: SSR Fade Angle Bias
Fields.Description: Bias on the fade of reflections that face the camera; smaller is higher quality. Retail: 0.1 Low, 0 Medium and High, -0.2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: SSR Fresnel Reject Bias
Fields.Description: Bias on the Fresnel-based rejection of reflections; smaller is higher quality. Retail: 0.1 Low, 0 Medium and High, -0.2 Maximum.
